egress.terms: free direct GET, plain text, no metering.

tooling: curl --data-binary @file https://paste.rs/ returns the URL on stdout; DELETE /<id> works; documented shell function for .bashrc. No wrapper ecosystem needed.
chaining: unlimited pastes x 384 KiB. 1 TiB = ~2.7M pastes. Only useful if an encoder pipeline is allowed to fan out aggressively; otherwise a control-plane store.
limits_note: 393,216 bytes hard; 'Pasting is heavily rate limited' (explicit in docs, no numeric limit published); no expiry documented; DELETE requires only the URL.
reliability_note: Silent truncation: it returns 206 Partial Content rather than an error, so a naive client will believe the full object was stored. Docs also state pasting is heavily rate limited.
